meta.name: niche-opportunity-finder
meta.description: Find untapped affiliate niches with real earning potential. Use this skill when the user asks about picking a niche, finding a niche to start affiliate marketing, what niche to get into, niche research, niche ideas, beginner niche selection, low competition niches, profitable niches, or says "I don't know what to promote", "help me pick a niche", "what niche should I start with", "find me a niche with less competition", "niche ideas for affiliate", "is X a good niche for affiliate marketing", "best niches 2024", "untapped niches".

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 发现低竞争高收益的联盟营销利基市场
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果从事联盟营销，苦于找不到竞争小的领域
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you do affiliate marketing and struggle to find niches with low competition.

howto.what: 当用户寻求利基选择时，Claude 会系统搜索和分析多个利基候选，从搜索需求、项目可用性、竞争程度和内容潜力四个维度打分，最终推荐一个高机会利基并生成详细报告。
howto.when: 当用户提到“挑选利基”、“利基研究”、“低竞争利基”等关键词，或说“我不知道推广什么”、“帮我选利基”时触发。

say.text: 帮我找一个低竞争的联盟营销利基。
say.note: 触发利基搜索与评分流程。

say.text: 我对AI工具感兴趣，有什么好的利基推荐？
say.note: 基于兴趣生成候选列表并打分。

say.text: 健身适合做联盟营销吗？
say.note: 验证该利基并建议细分方向。

howto.what_en: When user seeks niche selection advice, Claude systematically searches and analyzes multiple niche candidates, scoring them on search demand, program availability, competition, and content potential, then recommends a high-opportunity niche with a detailed report.
howto.when_en: Triggers when user mentions keywords like 'pick a niche', 'niche research', 'low competition niche', or says 'I don't know what to promote', 'help me pick a niche'.

say_en.text: Find a low-competition affiliate niche for me.
I'm interested in AI tools. Any good niche recommendations?
say_en.note: Generates candidates with scoring based on interest.

say_en.text: Is fitness a good niche for affiliate marketing?
say_en.note: Validates the niche and suggests micro-niches.
